sentences.en: Only sensationalist authors would claim that Berbers originate from Yemen.
sentences.zh: 只有那些喜欢制造轰动效应的作家才会声称柏柏人起源于也门。

sentences.en: The quarrel originated in rivalry between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 这场争执源自两国之间的竞争。

sentences.en: She originated a new way of playing jazz on the shamisen.
sentences.zh: 她开创了一种在三味线上演奏爵士乐的新方式。
